title: Portable table, backpack-mounted
description:
A surface that extends from a backpack for use where a lap would otherwise be used.

The weight of the pack on the ground keeps the surface level.
condition: Requires a loaded pack. A full water bottle is an acceptable ballast.

title: Textile sample, square, non-conforming
description:
A square that does not conform to the standard square.

Several variants exist. None conform in the same way.

title: Crocheted "Garment"
description: What seems to be a crocheted garment. Possibly unfinished.
hidden: An archivist has noted that this item seemed to have grown bigger with more crocheting added since initial pre-cataloguing inventory. If someone is adding to it. Please stop.
